defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It precomputes shortest distances between terminals and appears to reduce the problem to terminal-level distances, which cannot represent sharing of a non-priority Steiner vertex by multiple terminal paths.
It relies on Kruskal-style minimum-spanning-tree connectivity rather than optimizing a Steiner tree with optional non-priority intermediate vertices.
It applies ordinary Kruskal MST construction to the graph, which does not in general minimize the cost of connecting only the priority vertices when non-priority Steiner vertices may be shared.
